description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.

novel_features.name: SLA breach board
novel_features.description: See which open tickets are breaching or about to breach SLA, grouped by technician or client.

novel_features.name: Unbilled worklog
novel_features.description: Find logged worklog time that never landed on an invoice, totaled in dollars per client.

novel_features.name: Patch + alert risk
novel_features.description: List assets missing a critical patch that also have an active (unresolved) alert.

novel_features.name: Alert coverage
novel_features.description: Partition alerts into open (uncovered) vs resolved, grouped by client.

novel_features.name: Client 360
novel_features.description: One offline bundle of a client plus its sites, users, contracts, open tickets, assets, and open invoices.

novel_features.name: Stale tickets
novel_features.description: Open tickets with no conversation, note, or worklog activity in N days.

novel_features.name: Agent context pack
novel_features.description: Assemble a ticket plus its worklogs, client, and SLA into one agent-shaped JSON blob (conversation/notes fetched live).
